## Errors
### ERC1155FullSupplyBurnExceedsAccountTotalSupply
Error thrown when trying to burn more tokens than the total supply for a given id.


```solidity
error ERC1155FullSupplyBurnExceedsAccountTotalSupply(uint256 id, uint256 burnAmount, uint256 totalSupply);
```
